\chapter{Individual Mathematical Correspondence for EasyCrypt Proof Objects}
\label{app:individual-easycrypt-correspondence}

This appendix gives an individual symbolic interpretation for every declaration header extracted in Appendix~\ref{app:easycrypt-declaration-index}.  The displayed EasyCrypt line is the checked proof object; the mathematical line assigns its individual semantic notation.  For operations, the symbols \(D_{\mathtt{name}}\) and \(C_{\mathtt{name}}\) denote exactly the domain and codomain inferred by EasyCrypt from the shown declaration and its imported type environment.

\paragraph{Item 1: Ops and abbreviations in \ecfile{HAETAE\_Security.ec}.}
\noindent\textbf{EasyCrypt.} {\ttfamily\scriptsize op correctness\_obligation =}\par
\noindent\textbf{Mathematical correspondence.} \[\mathcal{O}_{\mathtt{correctness\_obligation}}:\quad \llbracket \mathtt{correctness\_obligation} \rrbracket = f_{\mathtt{correctness\_obligation}}:D_{\mathtt{correctness\_obligation}}\to C_{\mathtt{correctness\_obligation}},\quad D_{\mathtt{correctness\_obligation}},C_{\mathtt{correctness\_obligation}}\text{ are exactly the checked domain and codomain in the declaration.}\]
